verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission is designed to take approximately four to five days to reach the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'the Orion capsule will reach the moon in five days'; R4: 'take about four days to reach the moon'; R5: 'it will not be until day six of the mission—Monday, April 6—that the Artemis II crew will reach the neighborhood of the moon'; R6: 'the crew should get close to the Moon on Monday'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state or imply 4-5 days from launch to lunar vicinity, matching the claim precisely.
